spf_policy_enforcement.title: SPF Policy Enforcement Level
spf_policy_enforcement.description: The enforcement action taken when SPF checks fail for inbound messages

dkim_validation_enabled.title: DKIM Signature Validation Enabled
dkim_validation_enabled.description: Whether the mail server actively validates DKIM signatures on inbound messages

dmarc_policy_enforcement.title: DMARC Inbound Policy Enforcement Level
dmarc_policy_enforcement.description: The DMARC policy enforcement action applied to inbound messages that fail DMARC alignment checks

spam_filter_enabled.title: Spam Filter Enabled
spam_filter_enabled.description: Whether the spam filtering engine is actively enabled and processing inbound email

spam_score_threshold.title: Spam Score Threshold
spam_score_threshold.description: The numeric score threshold at or above which messages are classified as spam and actioned. Lower values are stricter; values above 10 effectively disable filtering.

spam_action_on_detection.title: Action Taken on Spam Detection
spam_action_on_detection.description: The enforcement action applied when a message exceeds the spam threshold

header_analysis_checks.title: Header Analysis Checks Enabled
header_analysis_checks.description: List of header-based analysis techniques active on the spam filter (e.g., received_chain, x_originating_ip, mime_structure, content_type_mismatch)

dmarc_record_present.title: DMARC Record Present
dmarc_record_present.description: Whether a valid DMARC TXT record exists at _dmarc.<domain> in DNS

dmarc_policy_level.title: DMARC Policy Level
dmarc_policy_level.description: The DMARC policy (p=) tag value in DNS, indicating the enforcement action receivers should take for unauthenticated mail. Also used for outbound policy assessment.

dmarc_pct_value.title: DMARC Percentage (pct) Tag Value
dmarc_pct_value.description: The pct= tag in the DMARC record indicating the percentage of messages that receive the DMARC enforcement action. 100 means full enforcement.

header_inspection_enabled.title: Header Inspection Enabled
header_inspection_enabled.description: Whether deep email header chain inspection is actively enabled on the mail server or security gateway

display_name_spoofing_check.title: Display Name Spoofing Detection Active
display_name_spoofing_check.description: Whether the system checks for mismatches between the display name and the actual sender email address to detect identity spoofing

reply_to_mismatch_action.title: Reply-To Mismatch Action
reply_to_mismatch_action.description: Action taken when the Reply-To header domain differs from the From header domain, indicating potential reply redirection to an attacker-controlled address

max_received_hops_exceeded.title: Maximum Received Hops Check Enabled
max_received_hops_exceeded.description: Whether a maximum hop-count threshold is configured on Received headers to flag anomalous routing; derived from max_received_hops_threshold being greater than 0

sandboxing_integration_enabled.title: Sandboxing Integration Enabled
sandboxing_integration_enabled.description: Whether the email platform is configured to route URLs and/or attachments to a sandboxing engine for pre-delivery detonation and analysis

sandbox_verdict_action.title: Sandbox Verdict Enforcement Action
sandbox_verdict_action.description: The action taken when the sandboxing engine returns a malicious verdict — whether messages are blocked/quarantined before delivery or only logged/allowed

sandbox_scope.title: Sandbox Analysis Scope
sandbox_scope.description: The content types submitted to the sandbox — should include both URLs and attachments to provide complete pre-delivery coverage

policy_applies_to_inbound.title: Policy Applies to Inbound Mail
policy_applies_to_inbound.description: Whether the sandboxing policy is scoped to cover inbound email traffic from external senders

logging_enabled.title: Message Logging Enabled
logging_enabled.description: Whether structured logging of all inbound and outbound message events is enabled on the email server

logged_fields.title: Logged Event Fields
logged_fields.description: List of event field types captured in the mail log, such as authentication_result, filter_verdict, delivery_status, sender, recipient, timestamp

log_retention_days.title: Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: Number of days mail delivery logs are retained before deletion or archival

dkim_signing_enabled.title: DKIM Signing Enabled
dkim_signing_enabled.description: Whether outbound messages are signed with a valid DKIM private key before delivery

authorized_sending_ip_policy.title: Authorized Sending IP Policy
authorized_sending_ip_policy.description: Whether an SPF record or equivalent IP allowlist restricts which IP ranges are permitted to send on behalf of the organization's domain

outbound_spam_filtering_enabled.title: Outbound Spam Filtering Enabled
outbound_spam_filtering_enabled.description: Whether outbound mail passes through a content/spam filter before leaving the organization's infrastructure

live_rule_update_supported.title: Live Rule Update Without Service Interruption
live_rule_update_supported.description: Whether filtering rules, blocklists, and authentication policies can be updated and applied without restarting the email service

rule_update_mechanism.title: Rule Update Mechanism
rule_update_mechanism.description: The mechanism by which filtering rules and authentication policies are updated — manual, scheduled, or automated/feed-driven

blocklist_last_updated_days_ago.title: Days Since Blocklist Last Updated
blocklist_last_updated_days_ago.description: Number of days elapsed since the spam/threat blocklist was last updated

quarantine_enabled.title: Quarantine Enabled
quarantine_enabled.description: Whether the email quarantine system is actively enabled and enforcing holding of suspect messages

retention_period_days.title: Quarantine Retention Period (Days)
retention_period_days.description: Number of days quarantined messages are retained before automatic deletion

user_release_interface_enabled.title: User Self-Release Interface Enabled
user_release_interface_enabled.description: Whether end users have access to a self-service interface to review and release their own quarantined messages

admin_review_notifications_enabled.title: Admin Review Notifications Enabled
admin_review_notifications_enabled.description: Whether administrators receive notifications or have a dashboard for reviewing quarantined messages to catch missed detections
